about: V1 round 3 review judgements. Same seed and population as round 2 (random.Random(20261106).sample over the sorted (model, id) pairs of the 100 spec tasks, n = 25); the sample is identical to round 2 (checked by diffing the --dump output against round 2). Changed since round 2 (diff of spec/ against the B1 base copy of round 2 and of the embedded r2 XML): L3 G1/G2/G5/G6 block, L4-02 G1 (F2, F3), G4 (F20, F21, F24) and A14 position, L4-03 A14 (REQs, src, binding, deadline, party, verify). Of the sample only L4-02 A14 changed (its flows); it was re-judged. The other 24 sampled tasks are byte-identical in their dump (label, lane, binding, deadline, party, REQ statements, finding paraphrases) and keep their round-2 verdict. L4-03 A14 (not in the sample) was re-judged as the round-2 GEN-03 finding.

other_findings.message: Sponsor sub-process entered by two message types through one start event: accepted by the orchestrator as one business trigger ('Intentional protocol deviation communicated'), with the deciding task A14 before G1 (conflicts.md C-27, rule_exceptions FLW-09, revisitable by the user). No repair needed.

New XOR split G5 'Intentional protocol deviation considered?' has no deciding activity before it (predecessor: AND split G1, then A1). notes.md section 6 names a trigger attribute - the investigator's consideration of an intentional protocol deviation (L4-03 S2), communicated by M11/M12 - but M11/M12 reach A3 only after the gateway, and unlike the trial-attribute gateways (EU CTR applies?, IND under 21 CFR 312?) the condition is not fixed at set-up but arises during conduct. Plausible only under the reading convention TA1 ('channels open in parallel ... only when an intentional protocol deviation is considered'); listed, like the round-1 FLW-08 reading-convention item, so that the user confirms the convention. No repair needed if confirmed.

notes.md section 6 row for G4 'Deviation from eligibility criteria requested?' quotes A12 as 'Request approval of intentional deviation'; the spec label is 'Request approval of intentional protocol deviation' (renamed in round 2 for LBL-04), so the table uses the short form the LBL-04 repair removed. Since round 2 the sponsor review A14 'Review intentional protocol deviation communication' carries REQ-075 (trigger 'Deviation from eligibility criteria requested') and precedes G1 -> G4, so the sponsor-side deciding activity for G4 is A14, which the row does not name. Repair (documentation only): correct the label and name A14 (content of the request from A12 via M3, reviewed by A14).

synthesis/l3_cut.md, A2 'Two channels, one trigger' (rewritten for the round-3 G1/G4 change) says the OR join G2 closes the channels 'before "Evaluate monitoring findings" and "Communicate detected deviations to investigator"'. No element is labelled 'Evaluate monitoring findings'; after G2 L4-02 has A10 'Document monitoring report' and A11 'Review monitoring reports' (then G3 and A12). One name for one thing: use the spec labels.
